🔁 MIX MODE mask (ACTIVE) — original reel kept, only she is swapped

widgets_values:
AIOFM ANIMATE — two modes

MOVE MODE (bypass the two MIX nodes to use): your girl performs the driving video's motion in HER scene (from the reference image). Off-frame events: not possible — the model only knows pose+face from the driving clip.

🔁 MIX MODE (DEFAULT — the off-frame answer): The original reel is kept 1:1 — background, camera moves, hands/objects entering from off-screen, ALL of it — and only the person is replaced with your girl. Pick reels that contain the events you want; they survive the swap. Relight LoRA (slot 0) matches her lighting to the scene.

CHANGES vs the b-1 original:
- 5-LoRA stack trimmed to relight + lightning-LOW. The old stack (FastWan+Pusa+HPS all @1.0) is the documented cause of plastic skin and identity drift. To restore: add them back in the LoRA stacker.
- NLF pose branch removed (VitPose path was the active one).
- Prompts filled (were empty — the model was flying blind).
- Runs on the AIOFM pod: needs ComfyUI-WanAnimatePreprocess pack + Animate model + relight LoRA + clip_vision_h (see download script section 2c).

481 frames @30fps = 16s per run. Context window 161/32 handles the length; expect identity softening past ~10s — plan a re-anchor cut or accept it.
